proposed.rule: overlay_rule_010
proposed.source_quote: Wer hat den Schaden verursacht?
proposed.case_quote: No identifiable third party caused or enlarged the loss apart from the unidentified thief.
proposed.reason: The responsible person is unidentified and no separate liability-insurer details can be established; the claim form can record that the thief is unidentified without requesting D14 as a separate document.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_043
proposed.source_quote: Lehnt der Versicherer die Entschädigungsforderung ab, muss sie der Anspruchsberechtigte innert 2 Jahren nach Eintritt des Ereignisses gerichtlich geltend machen, andernfalls er seine Rechte verliert (Verwirkung).
proposed.case_quote: The insurer has declined the claim for indemnity in writing.
proposed.reason: The case already states the rejection, and does not say the claimant is seeking to establish timely judicial assertion. The cited passage sets a consequence and does not require requesting the rejection letter as claim evidence in this case.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_004
proposed.source_quote: Der Anspruchsberechtigte ist verpflichtet, nach Eintritt des befürchteten Ereignisses tunlichst für Minderung des Schadens zu sorgen. Er muss, wenn nicht Gefahr im Verzug liegt, über die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen die Weisung des Versicherungsunternehmens einholen und befolgen.
proposed.case_quote: No repair costing more than CHF 500 is contemplated for the damaged insured items.
proposed.reason: The insurer's instructions may be relevant if mitigation measures were considered, but the case does not say whether instructions were issued or what mitigation measures were taken. Ask about those facts before requesting D25.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_020
proposed.source_quote: Hausrat und Wertsachen: Der Schaden wird entweder durch Sie oder uns selbst, durch einen gemeinsamen Experten oder in einem Verfahren durch einen Sachverständigen festgestellt.
proposed.case_quote: Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
proposed.reason: The source allows a jointly appointed expert as a route distinct from the formal procedure. The case rules out a request for the formal procedure but does not establish that the parties selected a joint expert.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_019
proposed.source_quote: Bestehen weitere Versicherungen für die obenerwähnten Sachen?
proposed.reason: The claim form calls for information about other insurance. The case does not establish whether other insurance exists, so the declaration should be completed rather than held until multiple insurance is confirmed.

proposed.source_quote: Wertsachenversicherung: Rechnungen, Quittungen, Schätzungen usw.

proposed.reason: An expert valuation is relevant if valuables-insurance coverage is being claimed, but the case does not establish that this is a valuables-insurance claim. Clarify the coverage sought before requesting D10.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_003
proposed.source_quote: Bevor der Schaden ermittelt ist, darf der Anspruchsberechtigte ohne Zustimmung des Versicherungsunternehmens an den beschädigten Gegenständen keine Veränderung vornehmen, welche die Feststellung der Schadensursache oder des Schadens erschweren oder vereiteln könnte, es sei denn die Veränderung erscheint zum Zweck der Schadensminderung oder im öffentlichen Interesse als geboten.

proposed.reason: The case describes a break-in but does not say whether damaged items have been altered or whether alteration is contemplated before loss determination. Clarify that fact before requesting consent evidence.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_071
proposed.source_quote: Leistungsansprüche gegenüber der CSS darf der Versicherungsnehmer nur mit schriftlicher Zustimmung der CSS an Dritte abtreten.
proposed.reason: The case does not say that the policyholder is assigning benefit claims or that a third party asserts entitlement through an assignment. Clarify whether such an assignment is involved before requesting consent.

proposed.source_quote: Sollten Sie den Mitwirkungspflichten zur Begründung des Versicherungsanspruches nicht nachkommen, können wir Sie schriftlich unter Ansetzung von einer Frist von 10 Tagen dazu auffordern. Sollten Sie dieser Aufforderung nicht nachkommen, entfällt die Leistungspflicht.

proposed.rule: The claim form’s responsible-person field is conditional on identifying a person
proposed.source_quote: Wer hat den Schaden verursacht?
proposed.case_quote: No identifiable third party caused or enlarged the loss apart from the unidentified thief.
proposed.reason: The only identified cause is an unidentified thief, so the form’s person-identification field does not make D14 a required document.

proposed.rule: An insurer instruction is relevant only if one was issued or loss mitigation is.
proposed.source_quote: Der Anspruchsberechtigte ist verpflichtet, nach Eintritt des befürchteten Ereignisses tunlichst für Minderung des Schadens zu sorgen. Er muss, wenn nicht Gefahr im Verzug liegt, über die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen die Weisung des Versicherungsunternehmens einholen und befolgen.
proposed.reason: The rule supports taking appropriate mitigation steps and following applicable instructions; it does not require requesting a standalone insurer-instruction document on these facts.

proposed.rule: A joint expert determination is only one optional route, not a required document
proposed.source_quote: Hausrat und Wertsachen: Der Schaden wird entweder durch Sie oder uns selbst, durch einen gemeinsamen Experten oder in einem Verfahren durch einen Sachverständigen festgestellt.
proposed.case_quote: Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
proposed.reason: The source allows the parties themselves, a joint expert, or formal proceedings to determine the loss; it does not require D23 absent selection of that route.

proposed.reason: Whether this item is required depends on the unresolved fact whether the bicycle was stolen. Ask the policyholder to clarify first.

proposed.reason: Whether this item is required depends on the unresolved fact whether the bicycle was stolen. Ask the policyholder to clarify first.

proposed.rule: The double-insurance declaration is required only if multiple insurance exists

proposed.reason: The case does not establish whether other insurance covering the same interest, risks, and period exists. Resolve that fact before requesting a multiple-insurance declaration.

proposed.rule: Insurer consent to altering damaged property is relevant only when an alteration

requests: Completed and signed claim notification form (Schadenanzeige Hausrat / Gebaeude), submitted in full to the address on its last page or through the insurer's online channel
Completed claim-form section identifying the person who caused the loss and his liability insurer (name, address, insurance company, Policen-Nr. / Schaden-Nr.)
Insurer's instruction (Weisung / Anordnung) on the measures to be taken, and evidence that it was followed
Joint expert's determination of the loss, where the parties appoint one expert instead of running the full expert procedure
Original purchase vouchers for the affected items (Originalbelege / Originalkaufbelege), including vouchers for the effective costs claimed under the insured cost heads
Payment instruction with payee name and address, IBAN and name of the financial institution
Police report on the theft (Polizeirapport / Polizeibeleg), which the insurer may call for, evidencing the person who laid the report, the date of the report, the police station and the officer
Signed valued inventory of the items present before and after the event and of the items affected (unterzeichnetes Verzeichnis mit Wertangaben), produced within any reasonable period the insurer sets
The insurance policy (Police), with the schedule of insured perils, locations, sums insured, deductible and additional covers
holds: Completed double-insurance declaration listing, per category, the other insurance company and policy number; the form marks this section as to be completed in every case
Expert's valuation of the scheduled valuable (Wertgutachten eines Sachverstaendigen / Schaetzung)
Insurer's consent to alteration of the damaged items before the loss is determined
Insurer's written consent to an assignment of the benefit claim to a third party
Insurer's written demand for the communications, under warning of the consequences of default, setting the period (10 days in the Generali wording)
Medical certificate (Arztzeugnis / aerztliche Bescheinigung) where a person was injured
Police consent to the removal or alteration of the Tatspuren
Receipt for the scheduled valuable (Quittung / Rechnung)
Release of the treating doctor from professional confidentiality
The experts' findings (Feststellungen der Sachverstaendigen), with the umpire's decision on points left in dispute
Written appointment of a Sachverstaendiger by each party, and the appointment of an umpire before determination begins
Written assignment to the insurer of the claims against third parties up to the amount of the benefits rendered, with the evidence needed to pursue them

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_001: notice is required once the claimant knows of the event and of
proposed.source_quote: Ist das befürchtete Ereignis eingetreten, so muss der Anspruchsberechtigte, sobald er von diesem Ereignisse und seinem Anspruche aus der Versicherung Kenntnis erlangt, das Versicherungsunternehmen benachrichtigen.
proposed.case_quote: After a hospital stay, a retired teacher in Lugano found his ground-floor apartment broken into on 19 August 2026. A coin collection and a television are gone; a neighbour alerted the police.
proposed.reason: The draft says the condition is unresolved, and the case does not establish when the claimant became aware of the insurance claim or whether the insurer was notified. Ask about those facts before requesting notice evidence.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_010 treats identifying the responsible person as required only inso
proposed.source_quote: Wer hat den Schaden verursacht?
proposed.case_quote: No identifiable third party caused or enlarged the loss apart from the unidentified thief.
proposed.reason: The case identifies only an unknown thief; the claim form's responsible-person information does not justify requesting D14 as a separate document in this case.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_004 requires evidence of measures and compliance with applicable
proposed.source_quote: Der Anspruchsberechtigte ist verpflichtet, nach Eintritt des befürchteten Ereignisses tunlichst für Minderung des Schadens zu sorgen. Er muss, wenn nicht Gefahr im Verzug liegt, über die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen die Weisung des Versicherungsunternehmens einholen und befolgen.
proposed.reason: A general duty to mitigate does not make the insurer's instruction document invariably required. No mitigation order or claimed costs arising from one are established here; do not request D25 on this trace.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_020 offers alternative routes for determining the loss; a joint ex
proposed.source_quote: Hausrat und Wertsachen: Der Schaden wird entweder durch Sie oder uns selbst, durch einen gemeinsamen Experten oder in einem Verfahren durch einen Sachverständigen festgestellt.
proposed.case_quote: Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
proposed.reason: The source allows the parties themselves to determine the loss or to use a common expert; it does not require a joint expert determination document in every claim. The case says neither party chose formal expert proceedings; no fact establishes selection of a joint expert route.

proposed.case_quote: A coin collection and a television are gone; a neighbour alerted the police.
proposed.reason: The cited passage calls for original receipts on request. The case does not establish that the insurer requested them, so hold rather than request D05 now.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_046 requests payment details for payment; the case does not estab
proposed.source_quote: Kontoangaben des Empfängers
proposed.reason: Nothing in the case establishes that payment information is currently required or that compensation is payable; hold D17 until payment details are needed.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_011 requires proof of item existence, value, and amount of loss
proposed.source_quote: Der Anspruchsberechtigte muss die Höhe des Schadens nachweisen.
proposed.reason: The general burden to prove loss amount does not make a signed inventory of all items present before and after the event invariably necessary. The inventory provision is on request, and no inventory request is stated; do not request D04 on these traces.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_007 requires establishing policy-designated locations and the
proposed.source_quote: Für den einfachen Diebstahl auswärts ist eine separate Zusatzversicherung abzuschliessen.
proposed.case_quote: After a hospital stay, a retired teacher in Lugano found his ground-floor apartment broken into on 19 August 2026. A coin collection and a television are gone; a neighbour alerted the police.
proposed.reason: A broken-in apartment and theft of household contents make the policy and schedule necessary to confirm insured location, insured theft peril, and relevant sums and terms.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_084 applies only if the claim concerns SIM-card misuse financial lo
proposed.source_quote: Vermögensschäden aufgrund von missbräuchlicher Nutzung von SIM-Karten, sofern sie nicht in der Zeit zwischen dem Diebstahl und der Meldung bei der CSS erfolgen.
proposed.case_quote: It is not yet known whether a SIM card was among the stolen items or whether any loss from SIM-card misuse will be claimed.
proposed.reason: The case leaves both theft of a SIM card and a claim for misuse losses unresolved. Hold any SIM-misuse evidence until asked whether such a loss is claimed; D33 is not an unconditional request.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_019 applies only if multiple insurance exists for the same interest
proposed.source_quote: Wird das durch diesen Vertrag versicherte Interesse gegen dieselben Gefahren und für dieselbe Zeit auch in anderen Versicherungsverträgen versichert (Mehrfachversicherung), muss dies dem Versicherer sofort mitgeteilt werden.
proposed.reason: No fact in the case establishes whether there is multiple insurance. Hold the declaration pending clarification rather than request it as a confirmed requirement.

proposed.rule: No claimed watch is identified; jewellery-limit rule does not make an expert
proposed.source_quote: Als Schmucksachen gelten auch Armband- und Taschenuhren mit Einzelwerten über CHF 5000.
proposed.case_quote: A coin collection and a television are gone; a neighbour alerted the police.
proposed.reason: The listed items are a coin collection and television, not a wristwatch or pocket watch. The watch-specific valuation condition does not apply.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_003 applies only when alteration of damaged property before loss
proposed.source_quote: Bevor der Schaden ermittelt ist, darf der Anspruchsberechtigte ohne Zustimmung des Versicherungsunternehmens an den beschädigten Gegenständen keine Veränderung vornehmen, welche die Feststellung der Schadensursache oder des Schadens erschweren oder vereiteln könnte, es sei denn die Veränderung erscheint zum Zweck der Schadensminderung oder im öffentlichen Interesse als geboten.
proposed.reason: There is no statement that alteration of damaged items is contemplated. The conditional consent document is not presently required.

proposed.case_quote: Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
proposed.reason: The rule does not require a joint expert determination document in every case. The case expressly says neither party chose the formal expert procedure, and does not say a joint expert was appointed.

proposed.rule: The responsible person's identity or available information is required, but the
proposed.source_quote: Wer hat den Schaden verursacht?
proposed.case_quote: No identifiable third party caused or enlarged the loss apart from the unidentified thief.
proposed.reason: The draft's trace says D14 is always required, but the source field asks who caused the loss. proposed.case_quote: the police and the insurer were notified.
proposed.reason: The draft has D01, but its condition was judged unresolved and the case does not establish that a completed claim form was used. The stated notification requires evidence of notice; D02 is an accepted alternative route and is missing.

proposed.source_quote: Die CSS Versicherung AG (nachfolgend «CSS» genannt) versichert die Gefahren von Feuer, Elementarereignissen, Erdbeben und vulkanischen Eruptionen, Wasser, Diebstahl sowie Glasbruch.

proposed.reason: The draft treats D03 as required for CSS coverage, but the case does not identify the insurer or establish that CSS coverage is sought. Hold until the carrier and applicable coverage are clarified.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_010
proposed.source_quote: Wer hat den Schaden verursacht?
proposed.case_quote: No identifiable third party caused or enlarged the loss apart from the unidentified thief.
proposed.reason: The responsible person is unidentified, so a completed identification of that person is not presently obtainable or required.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_020
proposed.source_quote: Hausrat und Wertsachen: Der Schaden wird entweder durch Sie oder uns selbst, durch einen gemeinsamen Experten oder in einem Verfahren durch einen Sachverständigen festgestellt.
proposed.case_quote: Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
proposed.reason: A joint expert is only one possible loss-determination route; the source does not require this document where that route has not been selected.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_014
proposed.source_quote: und auf Verlangen, ein Verzeichnis der vom Schaden betroffenen Sachen mit Wertangaben zu erstellen und Originalbelege beizubringen;
proposed.reason: Original receipts are required on request; the case does not say the insurer requested them. The rule's cited source does not make receipts mandatory merely because items were stolen.

proposed.rule: overlay_rule_004
proposed.source_quote: Der Anspruchsberechtigte ist verpflichtet, nach Eintritt des befürchteten Ereignisses tunlichst für Minderung des Schadens zu sorgen. Er muss, wenn nicht Gefahr im Verzug liegt, über die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen die Weisung des Versicherungsunternehmens einholen und befolgen.
proposed.case_quote: Burglars entered a family's detached house near Winterthur through the terrace door during the night of 5 September 2026. Musical instruments and a sewing machine are missing; the police and the insurer were notified.
proposed.reason: Whether insurer instructions were sought or issued, and whether mitigation measures are relevant, is unresolved. Do not request this document until those facts are clarified.

proposed.reason: Payment account details are required for payment, but the case does not establish that payment information is currently required. Hold pending clarification of the payment stage.

proposed.reason: No assignment of benefit claims to a third party is stated or indicated; the consent document is not required on these facts.

proposed.case_quote: Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
proposed.reason: No expert-procedure route has been selected, and no expert findings exist to request.

applied.case_quote: No identifiable third party caused or enlarged the loss apart from the unidentified thief.
applied.reason: The only possible perpetrator is unidentified, so the claim form's responsible-person field does not require a separate D14 document.
applied.document_name: Completed claim-form section identifying the person who caused the loss and his liability insurer (name, address, insurance company, Policen-Nr. / Schaden-Nr.)

applied.rule: overlay_rule_004
applied.source_quote: Der Anspruchsberechtigte ist verpflichtet, nach Eintritt des befürchteten Ereignisses tunlichst für Minderung des Schadens zu sorgen. Er muss, wenn nicht Gefahr im Verzug liegt, über die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen die Weisung des Versicherungsunternehmens einholen und befolgen.
applied.case_quote: The insurer sent a written demand warning that the claim will be forfeited unless the requested communications are supplied within 10 days.
applied.reason: Whether there were insurer instructions on mitigation and whether they were followed is unresolved; the demand about communications does not establish a mitigation instruction.
applied.document_name: Insurer's instruction (Weisung / Anordnung) on the measures to be taken, and evidence that it was followed

applied.rule: overlay_rule_020 allows the parties themselves, a common expert, or formal Sachv
applied.source_quote: Hausrat und Wertsachen: Der Schaden wird entweder durch Sie oder uns selbst, durch einen gemeinsamen Experten oder in einem Verfahren durch einen Sachverständigen festgestellt.
applied.case_quote: Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
applied.reason: The source allows the parties to determine the loss themselves; it does not require a joint expert determination document.
applied.document_name: Joint expert's determination of the loss, where the parties appoint one expert instead of running the full expert procedure

applied.rule: overlay_rule_046 makes payment details relevant to payment, but payment is not
applied.source_quote: Kontoangaben des Empfängers
applied.reason: No case fact shows payment is currently being made or payment information is required; the payment-field source alone does not establish that condition.
applied.document_name: Payment instruction with payee name and address, IBAN and name of the financial institution

applied.rule: overlay_rule_014 is conditional on a request for original purchase evidence or
applied.source_quote: und auf Verlangen, ein Verzeichnis der vom Schaden betroffenen Sachen mit Wertangaben zu erstellen und Originalbelege beizubringen;
applied.case_quote: The insurer sent a written demand warning that the claim will be forfeited unless the requested communications are supplied within 10 days.
applied.reason: The demand is described as requesting communications, not original purchase receipts; the source makes production of original receipts conditional on request.
applied.document_name: Original purchase vouchers for the affected items (Originalbelege / Originalkaufbelege), including vouchers for the effective costs claimed under the insured cost heads

applied.rule: overlay_rule_002
applied.source_quote: Hausratversicherung Diebstahl: Diebstahlschäden müssen Sie der Polizei anzeigen, damit eine amtliche Untersuchung durchgeführt wird.
applied.case_quote: A student sharing a flat in Lucerne found the balcony door pried open on the morning of 2 July 2026. A games console and headphones were taken; she told the police and the insurer.
applied.reason: The case says police were told but does not resolve when, or establish that an official investigation was requested. The report requirement depends on prompt reporting and the status/details remain unresolved.
applied.document_name: Police report on the theft (Polizeirapport / Polizeibeleg), which the insurer may call for, evidencing the person who laid the report, the date of the report, the police station and the officer

applied.rule: overlay_rule_011 / overlay_rule_013
applied.source_quote: Der Anspruchsberechtigte muss die Höhe des Schadens nachweisen.
applied.case_quote: A games console and headphones were taken; she told the police and the insurer.
applied.reason: The claimant must prove the amount and existence/value of affected items, but it is unresolved whether the requested signed inventory or D04 is the evidence required; hold pending clarification of what evidence is available or requested.
applied.document_name: Signed valued inventory of the items present before and after the event and of the items affected (unterzeichnetes Verzeichnis mit Wertangaben), produced within any reasonable period the insurer sets

applied.rule: overlay_rule_094
applied.source_quote: Die CSS Versicherung AG (nachfolgend «CSS» genannt) versichert die Gefahren von Feuer, Elementarereignissen, Erdbeben und vulkanischen Eruptionen, Wasser, Diebstahl sowie Glasbruch.
applied.case_quote: A student sharing a flat in Lucerne found the balcony door pried open on the morning of 2 July 2026. A games console and headphones were taken; she told the police and the insurer.
applied.reason: The insurer and applicable policy coverage are not identified in the case; whether the CSS rule applies remains unresolved.
applied.document_name: The insurance policy (Police), with the schedule of insured perils, locations, sums insured, deductible and additional covers

ignored.rule: overlay_rule_016
ignored.source_quote: Wertsachenversicherung: Rechnungen, Quittungen, Schätzungen usw.
ignored.case_quote: No stolen item is separately scheduled in the policy with an insured value of CHF 1,000 or more.
ignored.reason: The claim is not stated to concern valuables insurance and the case expressly excludes the scheduled-value trigger.

ignored.rule: overlay_rule_003
ignored.source_quote: Bevor der Schaden ermittelt ist, darf der Anspruchsberechtigte ohne Zustimmung des Versicherungsunternehmens an den beschädigten Gegenständen keine Veränderung vornehmen, welche die Feststellung der Schadensursache oder des Schadens erschweren oder vereiteln könnte, es sei denn die Veränderung erscheint zum Zweck der Schadensminderung oder im öffentlichen Interesse als geboten.
ignored.case_quote: No repair costing more than CHF 500 is contemplated for the damaged insured items.
ignored.reason: No alteration to damaged property before assessment is established; the case only addresses repair costs over CHF 500.

ignored.rule: overlay_rule_071
ignored.source_quote: Leistungsansprüche gegenüber der CSS darf der Versicherungsnehmer nur mit schriftlicher Zustimmung der CSS an Dritte abtreten.
ignored.reason: Nothing indicates that the policyholder seeks to assign benefit claims to a third party.

ignored.rule: overlay_rule_017
ignored.source_quote: Arztzeugnis (bei Personenschaden)
ignored.case_quote: A games console and headphones were taken; she told the police and the insurer.
ignored.reason: The case does not indicate bodily injury; a medical certificate is not required on the stated facts.
